meta.title: Devlog: September 27, 2026 - October 4, 2026
meta.description: guest bookclubr voting expanded, while android support for due or die and a new shared-reading app moved forward.

bullets.text: continued android work on more forceful deadline alerts, including full-screen alarm controls, sound, vibration, and lock-screen behavior.
continued android task countdown work so upcoming deadlines can remain visible in a lock-screen notification.
continued improving android app blocking with a dedicated block screen that can keep users focused when a configured lock is active.
continued refining android permission guidance and settings flows for alarms, notifications, and app blocking.
improved keyboard behavior and first-task permission setup across supported mobile platforms.

summary.text: i spent a lot of this week making the android version feel less like an afterthought. it is still in progress, but the core deadline and blocking experience is taking shape.

bullets.text: shipped a bookclubr landing page and browser-based guest voting so invited readers can participate without downloading the app.
added live turnout during open guest votes and full final rankings once organizers close voting.
let guests nominate one book from the shared vote page before voting begins, with a synchronized countdown into ranked voting.
added a name field for guest nominations so suggestions can be identified in club history.
kept guest ballot links out of site analytics paths.

summary.text: i wanted guest voting to feel like a real part of bookclubr rather than a side quest. now people can suggest a book, see the room warming up, vote, and follow the final result from one shared page.

bullets.text: released the initial shared-reading app with profiles, friend requests, personal shelves, book search, and reviews.
released public reading clubs with member roles, reading goals, progress updates, reactions, replies, and club activity.
released organizer-led ranked book voting, including member nominations, guest vote links, vote results, and tie handling.
released notifications for reading and club activity, along with calendar support for reading deadlines.

summary.text: i got the first version of this shared-reading app out into the world. there are a lot of moving parts, but the main loop of finding books, reading together, and picking the next one is now there.
